response.body: {"code":"422","errors":{"phone":["Invalid CM Mobile Money"]},"message":"Invalid CM Mobile Money","status":"Unprocessable Content"}

why: Notch Pay's sandbox answered exactly this body on 2026-10-23 to process an Orange number (+23769...)
adapter maps a process 422 naming only phone to Rejected { invalid_payer } (the maintainer's choice,
of the accepting mapping, which would otherwise match the same request.

mappings.name: process accepted (202, processing) -- by Notch Pay's trx. reference, cm.mobile, cm.mtn or cm.orange, and a +-prefixed number under data.phone

why: Process, addressed by Notch Pay's own reference (trx.test_<our reference> in this stub), as
Notch Pay's sandbox required on 2026-10-21: it answered 404 to a process call by our reference
that addressed it by ours matches nothing and gets WireMock's 404, which is Malformed on a process
call. The answer names our reference as trxref and carries no id, as the sandbox's did.
data.phone and cm.mobile were accepted by the sandbox. cm.mtn and cm.orange are the channels a
charge routed by method type sends since 2026-10-23 (RFC-0012 delivery step 8); Notch Pay's channel
table documents both, and the sandbox has not been asked them.
